svg.title: SR fault validation board -- assembly and DNP drawing
svg.text: SR fault validation board (PCB-FAB-01) -- assembly and DNP drawing, 1:1 top side
Scale 1:1 at A4. All 71 placements are on F.Cu (top side); the board is single-sided assembly.
10 parts are DNP -- hatched red, marked on the board and listed in red below. Their lands stay bare; they are excluded from the position file.
Not an approval: hardware_built and fabrication_approved are false. DRC covers copper only -- no thermal, EMC or first-article review has been done.
Footprints are vendored from hardware/stock_footprints (sha256 in PROVENANCE.md) except dcx:BSC010N04LS6, which is drawn from the datasheet land pattern.
